name: Alruna
personality: Alruna holds herself in high regard, viewing herself as a guide for those who are willing to help join the battle to restore the world back to its prior state. Her movements are carried with the elegance of a graceful goddess, and her words, practiced as if telling a fable. The guide from the water’s depths speaks not of the lost paths.

abilities.name: Water
abilities.description: Able to swim/breathe/dive underwater for far longer periods of time than other pokemons.

abilities.name: Rain Rider
abilities.description: When the air is full of moisture, Alruna can fly. The more moist it is, the better she can fly.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.description: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

abilities.name: Guidance of Seas
abilities.description: Allies will be healed for 25% of the healing Alruna receives. If this healing is excess healing, the portion considered from the excess is increased to 50%.

abilities.name: Channel Primal Waters
abilities.description: When Alruna is directly healed by an ally, she gains a raise in Sp. ATK.

moves.name: Defend Order
moves.description: The user raises its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Tailwing
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.description: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user summons a ring of water that will gradually restore its HP.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.name: Origin Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

moves.name: Refreshing Waters
moves.description: The user heals all its allies and raises their Defense and Sp. Def stats.

backstory:
One story tells of a whalelike creature that commanded the vast oceans, and the waters in the sky.
It summoned downpours with a mere thought, quenched those plagued with drought, and yet, for all there was to its fables, it merely slumbered, sealed away by a curse.
Sealed away deep, deep away, in the dark blue depths.
...
Another story tells of a supposed fairy and a young girl, lost in the depths of a mysterious cavern.
A masquerain and a helioptile. 
The fairy guided the lost youth through the caverns. Grateful as she was, she happily followed along.
Deeper into the caves, until the two saw a grand, massive whale.
…
And then the world simply fell apart.
...
The whale of many fables simply awoke in the cavern’s depths. 
The shell of stone coating its prior form, crumbling away before its eyes.
The helioptile, nowhere to be seen.
...
Many speak of adventures.
Others, speak of contradictions.
A creature who flies in the seas and the air.
A creature who cannot fly if its wings get wet.
...
By conflicting, it simply negates out into a neutral.
To this new world, shall she draw her wings in flight.
Shall she guide them forevermore.
